source.name: ethos Greek Bistro official website
source.rightsEvidence: The requester attested on 2026-09-25 that permission covers full-page screenshot retention, derived design prompts, and sending screenshots to the pipeline model as visual reference. The source-specific grant was not attached.

provenance.discoveryContext: Found during direct-source search for contemporary local restaurant experiences. No gallery screenshot or downloaded source media was retained.
provenance.capture: Captured from the official live domain at 1440x1000 and 390x844 after scrolling the entire page to load lazy images and reveal content. No source HTML, assets, or page state was changed.
provenance.diagnostics: All 54 image elements decoded, zero broken images, and document width matched 1440px desktop and 390px mobile.
provenance.attribution: ethos Greek Bistro is the captured direct site. Screenshots are retained for internal visual reference and model input only under requester attestation.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A direct restaurant site opens over full-bleed interior photography, with circular shortcuts to menu, catering, order and location actions. A light editorial restaurant introduction follows, then a cinematic food chapter, editorial/blog update circles, a three-choice action strip, a review panel, signature menu/gallery, and a dense dark footer with contact and hours. All brand words, food, reviews, addresses, offers, staff and rating content are source-specific and must not be transferred.

heroGeometry.mode: immersive dining photograph with circular task navigation
heroGeometry.alignment: full-bleed restaurant scene, small brand at top, circle shortcuts positioned in image-safe areas
heroGeometry.viewport: clear identity and primary menu/reservation task visible in the opening

navigationGeometry.mode: thin utility header plus image-anchored circular shortcuts
navigationGeometry.placement: micro row at top, additional high-level routes over the hero photograph
navigationGeometry.mobile: preserve a few large touch-safe circular actions and move remaining links to a text row

typography.scale: small navigational labels, medium welcome heading, large menu/gallery captions

palette.contrastIntent: photographic drama at hero, quiet warm reading surfaces and high-contrast action controls

imageTreatment.mode: full-bleed restaurant interiors, cinematic food/process scene, and varied dish gallery
imageTreatment.crop: wide cover hero, alternating large story panels, compact image gallery
imageTreatment.focalPoint: real dining room or food object remains legible behind task labels

servicePresentation.pattern: separate menu, ordering, event/catering and location tasks rather than one generic service grid
servicePresentation.interaction: direct anchor navigation and functional online-order/reservation routes only when connected

ctaPlacement.primary: menu or reservation task in hero shortcut
ctaPlacement.early: over the opening image, with a text fallback immediately beneath it

motion.primitive: small circular anchor navigation, story image reveal and gallery controls
motion.reducedMotion: still poster image and all navigation/gallery content available in static sequence

mobileRecomposition.strategy: photo-led single column with large task buttons
rules: limit circular shortcuts to what fits as readable touch targets
move extra routes into a simple text row
stack restaurant story and service choices
keep menu, location and primary action visible

prohibitedPatterns: copied brand, food photography, menu, location, hours or source copy
invented table availability, delivery, allergy claims, customer ratings or awards
circular controls too small to tap

requiredSignatureElements.description: clear circular shortcut navigation over the dining image
calmer editorial introduction after the image-led hero
food or place gallery that is not used as unsupported client proof

acceptanceChecks: restaurant identity and real location are visible as text
menu, hours and location details match verified business data
every action maps to an actual endpoint or route
reviews and ratings are authentic and approved or omitted
no source image, copy or brand enters client output

review.scope: direct-site paired screenshots, visual-mechanics prompt and requester attestation; no owner grant file uploaded
